trees.title: The Simpsons
trees.blurb: Cartoon family used as a small demo. Portraits are not in the repository; fetch-portraits downloads them from the Simpsons wiki onto your machine.
trees.license: Names and relationships from the published series. Not a Fox product. Character portraits are not distributed; npm run fetch-portraits downloads them from the Simpsons Fandom wiki.

trees.title: European royalty (royal92)
trees.blurb: Classic public-domain GEDCOM, ~3,000 people. Weak on French/Spanish lines.

trees.title: Duck family (DuckTales)
trees.blurb: Don Rosa's Clan McDuck / Duck / Coot tree, which the DuckTales shows use. Not a mix of every contradictory comic.
trees.license: Names and relationships from Don Rosa's published Duck Family Tree and episode guides. Not a Disney product. Character portraits are not distributed; npm run fetch-portraits downloads them from the Disney and DuckTales Fandom wikis.

trees.title: Westeros kings
trees.blurb: GenoPro Song of Ice and Fire kingdom tree, fetched from its public origin. Portraits are not in the repository; fetch-portraits downloads them from A Wiki of Ice and Fire onto your machine.
trees.license: GEDCOM from the public GenoPro tree by AngelEyes (Kings of Westeros). Not a genealogical authority and not an HBO product. Character portraits are not distributed; npm run fetch-portraits downloads them from A Wiki of Ice and Fire.

trees.title: Harry Potter family
trees.blurb: Fan family tree of the Potter, Weasley, Black, and related lines. Portraits are not in the repository; fetch-portraits downloads them from the Harry Potter wiki onto your machine.
trees.license: Names and relationships from the published books. Not a Warner Bros. product. Character portraits are not distributed; npm run fetch-portraits downloads them from the Harry Potter Fandom wiki.
